# javaabu/activitylog

> Activity logs for Laravel, built on spatie/laravel-activitylog v5. Add the LogsActivity trait to a model and its changed fillable attributes are logged, never hidden or sensitive attributes, the key or timestamps; customize it with spatie's getActivitylogOptions() starting from defaultActivitylogOptions(). Every log has a tag (colour, icon, translated label) and a readable description in the reader's language. Route::activitylog() adds the activity log, a record's history and each log's changes (Blade or Inertia React, with javaabu/filters), rollback to a log's version, and exports with javaabu/exports; a policy and permissions come through javaabu/permissions.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/activitylog/.

## Rules

- Log models with `use Javaabu\Activitylog\Traits\LogsActivity;`. Don't add v1's static properties (`$logAttributes`, `$ignoreChangedAttributes`, `$logExceptAttributes`): they throw. Override `getActivitylogOptions(): LogOptions` and start from `$this->defaultActivitylogOptions()`; `LogOptions` is `Spatie\Activitylog\Support\LogOptions` (spatie v5), not `Spatie\Activitylog\LogOptions`.
- `logExcept()` replaces the list: merge `$this->activitylogExceptAttributes()` back in so hidden and sensitive attributes stay out.
- This is spatie v5: `$model->activitiesAsSubject`, `$user->activitiesAsCauser`, `$log->attribute_changes` (or the package's `$log->changes()`, `newValues()`, `oldValues()`), `getProperty()`, `dontLogEmptyChanges()`, `Activity::defaultCauser()`. There's no `LogBatch`.
- For anything that isn't a model event, use `activity()->performedOn($model)->causedBy($user)->event('sent')->log('sent')`. Always set an `event` so the log gets a tag and description; pass changes with `withChanges(['attributes' => [...], 'old' => [...]])`, not `withProperties()`.
- Don't store readable sentences in `description`; they're built when shown with `$log->describe()`. Customize them with `describeActivity()` on the model, `Activitylog::describe($event, $template, Model::class)` or `activitylog.descriptions`. Templates go through `__()`; add Dhivehi to `lang/dv.json`.
- Add tags for your events with `Activitylog::registerTags(MyTags::class)` (a backed enum implementing `Javaabu\Activitylog\Contracts\Tag`), `Activitylog::registerTag()`, `activitylog.tags`, or a model's static `activitylogTags()`. Colours are javaabu/forms status colours.
- Register the pages yourself with `Route::activitylog([...])` inside the app's route group; pass `guard`, `prefix` and `name` for an admin guard. They aren't loaded automatically.
- Permissions are `view_logs`, `view_all_logs`, `rollback_logs` and `export_logs`; run `php artisan permissions:sync`. Query what a user may see with `Activity::visibleTo($user)`. Override the policy with `config('permissions.policies')` or `Gate::policy()`, never by editing the package.
- Show a record's history with `<x-activitylog::history :subject="$model" />` (Blade) or `Activitylog::history($model)` + `<ActivityHistory history={history} />` (React). Don't write your own query of `subject_type`/`subject_id`.
- Roll back with `$log->rollback()->perform($user)` after `$user->can('rollback', $log)`; never by copying old values by hand. It restores the version right after the log and logs `rolled_back`.
- Publish `config/activitylog.php` from this package (`--tag=activitylog-config`), not spatie's; `activity_model` must be `Javaabu\Activitylog\Models\Activity` or a subclass. Don't publish spatie's migration.
- Use Thaana in tests of user-facing log behaviour, and logical CSS (`ms-`, `pe-`) in views.
